scenario.name: m3_wash_closed_loop
scenario.description: Pressure sensor at the mesh and outlet absorbance on: the model is corrected as the run goes.

events.narration: Load 10,000 capsules through the top inlet; they settle in a single layer on the mesh.
events.explanation: Fastest safe option of 3 simulated (0 rejected): load 20 uL at 40 uL/min, predicted 30 s, 93.4% exchanged, peak 2.00 kPa.

events.narration: Wash three times: buffer flows down through the mesh to waste while the capsules stay on top.
events.explanation: Fastest safe option of 16 simulated (7 rejected): exchange 4 x 20 uL wash_buffer at 40 uL/min + 72 s soak, predicted 192 s, 100.0% exchanged, peak 2.00 kPa.

model_updates.reason: outlet absorbance 0.913 after 16 uL: leftover old liquid -23% vs the model since the exchange began

events.narration: Wash three times: buffer flows down through the mesh to waste while the capsules stay on top. (re-planned)
events.explanation: Re-planned after a model update: Fastest safe option of 16 simulated (4 rejected): exchange 3 x 20 uL wash_buffer at 40 uL/min + 77 s soak, predicted 167 s, 100.0% exchanged, peak 2.46 kPa.

model_updates.reason: outlet absorbance 0.966 after 24 uL: leftover old liquid +16% vs the model since the exchange began

events.narration: Back-flush from below to lift the capsules off the mesh and resuspend them.
events.explanation: Fastest safe option of 8 simulated (5 rejected): exchange back-flush 1 x 20 uL resuspension_buffer at 60 uL/min, predicted 20 s, 94.2% exchanged, peak -3.70 kPa.

model_updates.reason: outlet absorbance 0.953 after 20 uL: leftover old liquid -18% vs the model since the exchange began

events.narration: Flush the washed capsules out through the release outlet.
events.explanation: Fastest safe option of 9 simulated (3 rejected): release 26.7 uL at 40 uL/min, predicted 40 s, 99.9% exchanged.
